full_story:
My name is Hung, but you can call me CK. I’m naturally curious, creative, and always looking for a different way to see everthing, also a data-driven individual, a numbers-and-fact-based evidence advocate. 

Over the past 7+ years, my career has taken me across marketing, business development, product and project management in gaming, esports and digital products. I started with hands-on marketing and user growth across both domestic and international markets with Garena’s Free Fire team, one of the leading companies in the global gaming and esports industry. 
I later expanded into strategic business development, and moving into product and project management at VTV Live / ON Live, where I worked in a young, startup-like environment with the ambition of bringing esports further into Vietnam’s mainstream media ecosystem.

I love diving deep into researching how users live, empathy is the cornerstone of creating intuitive and forward-thinking products.

**Open to:** Product, Product Marketing, Marketing and Business Development roles across industries
summary: 7+ years in product, marketing and business development, from Garena Free Fire to VTV Live (ON Live). Open to roles across industries.
Product, marketing and business development in one profile: I connect users with product, partnerships, and revenue.

Proof: 
- Product: 380K+ MAU, 20K+ DAU, <0.7USD CAC (Vietnam market), Payrate >1%
- Business Development: Generated >USD 300K in revenue from production & licensing of content 
- Marketing: Built social media ecosystems across markets, achieved >1B views in a campaign, experienced in market research, identifying ICPs
**Open to:** Product, Product Marketing, Marketing and Business Development roles across other new industries as well as gaming and esports.
